There is no obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or system modifications.

The use of `!strip` and `!debug` in `options` is appropriate for a binary-only package where stripping or debugging tools could interfere with the precompiled binaries. The package conflicts and provides correct virtual packages to avoid co-installation with other kitty variants. All actions are consistent with standard AUR packaging practices for a nightly binary release.
</details>
